notes: TBox delete of a stored rule. Members stay in the class in every world; a world with the member's value stored by name keeps it, a world that reached it only through the rule loses it (stores). The core-fusion processes are individuals. No answer of the delete rests on one value per member (each is the original or does-not-know), so the earlier firm one-value rule is dropped (2026-10-31). q1 reads 'Is helium the fuel?' as fusing hydrogen into helium, and q3 'does the fusion produce helium?' as fusing hydrogen into helium (the two processes in play).
